# Live recorded-iteration interface witness

Exercise the implemented assisted iteration MCP interface against the committed assisted-iteration-records feature without modifying source. Register a focused iteration and a broader iteration, retrieve original IDs, full commits, server timestamps and Git cleanliness provenance, replay start, end the focused iteration with the existing candidate, replay end, and retrieve the completed real assessment. Reconnect and retrieve the same retained information. Leave the broader iteration honestly started and not assessed.

Acceptance: requests use the actual official MCP client and runtime; start launches no assessment; end submits the existing committed candidate to the configured audit and Pi; retries preserve IDs and timestamps without extra attempts; the completed assessment has its actual gate and completion time. Preserve original audit provenance and reuse. This is a bounded protocol and persistence witness, not evidence of worker-effort savings or active implementation time. Scripted tests carry repair, overlap, moving HEAD and recovery fault coverage.

result.summary: Assessment has required evidence gaps; established issues are retained.
gaps: Review coverage incomplete: No reviewer-accessible post-submission live MCP result, end-retry/reconnect transcript, final assessment gate or completedAt is supplied. The passed reused audit stage is factual check evidence, not proof of the eventual composed gate; actual timing must come from the completed retained assessment, not from the audit's historical run time.

captured-plan: The inspected implementation supports the captured plan's start/end, immutable provenance, replay, restart and audit/Pi composition. The supplied coordinator observation reports focused and broader starts, exact start replay and retention after a clean restart before this end; the audit stage confirms a passed reused provider result for this candidate. However, the reviewer tools expose neither the actual live MCP call log nor the later replay of this end, completed assessment_result/detail and post-completion reconnect. Those final witness steps cannot be independently confirmed at this review stage. This is an evidence limit, not an assertion that the interface is unimplemented; the broader iteration should remain unassessed.

A second broader iteration remains started and not assessed.
